Since you brought it up, it might be a good idea to add some unit tests for `ParentInjectorPromise`/`SyncPromise` now that their logic is not trivial :wink:

I tried to write a test for this and I could indeed not reproduce the issue. Looking at the code more closely, I see that `finalParentInjector`/`finalModuleInjector` can be either (a) an actual `Promise` (in which case the current code is fine) or (b) an `Injector` instance (in which case the current code is fine) or (c) a `ParentInjectorPromise` (which is what supposedly cases the issue). 

In case (c), while `ParentPromiseInjector` is not resolved, then it should indeed act as a `Promise`, so the current code is fine too. And as soon as it is resolved, we [replace the data on the element][1] with the actual `Injector` instance, so child descendants should be able to grad the instances directly.

So, I am not sure under what circumstances the problem would mnifest itself.
@brannislav, could you share more details about the failure you are seeing (e.g. post the test code that is failing for you)?

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/32886cf9ace539e14e2b387cd8afb10715c8d3de/packages/upgrade/src/common/src/downgrade_component.ts#L246
